description: A-11 cross-language vector: the worker-credential document as Node's HarnessAuthority.provision wrote it through createHarnessAuthorityStores(KeyValueStoreService) to Redis 7. 'stored' is the raw Redis value at redisKeyPrefix + path (Node's EncryptionService output, iv:ciphertext:authTag). The Python worker must read 'document' back through ConfigurationService with SECRET_KEY = 'secretKey'. Throwaway secret; regenerate by provisioning on an empty Redis and copying GET <redisKey>.
